question: Which of the following statements about the Chithirai Festival of Madurai is correct?

options.text: The Chithirai Festival is celebrated in the tamil month of Margazhi
Lord Kallazhagar arrives on a golden horse
The festival is held exclusively in December
The festival ends with a game of bullfight

solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Kallazhagar arrives on a golden horse**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Chithirai Festival is one of the most famous festivals of Tamil Nadu, celebrated annually in Madurai during the Tamil month of Chithirai (April-May).
 
• The festival reenacts the celestial wedding of Goddess Meenakshi (an avatar of Parvati) and Lord Sundareswarar (an avatar of Shiva).
 
• A significant highlight of the festival is the arrival of Lord Kallazhagar (an avatar of Vishnu) to the Vaigai River on a golden horse to bless the wedding of his sister Meenakshi.
 
• Lord Kallazhagar's journey from his temple in Alagar Kovil to Madurai is celebrated with great fervor and devotion, drawing thousands of devotees.
 
• The event symbolizes the unity of the Shaivite (followers of Shiva) and Vaishnavite (followers of Vishnu) traditions in Tamil culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Festivals**

 
 
• Pongal: A four-day harvest festival giving thanks to the Sun God, featuring traditional cooking, cattle worship, and the famous Jallikattu bull sport in Madurai.
 
• Puthandu (Tamil New Year): Celebrated in mid-April (Chittirai month) with traditional customs and feasts.
 
• Thaipusam: Devotees carry milk pots to temples for Lord Murugan (Kartikeya).
 
• Karthigai Deepam: A ten-day festival marked by new clothes, gifts, and temple celebrations, with large lamps lit.
 
• Diwali (Deepavali): The festival of lights, celebrated with lamps, sweets, and family gatherings.
